transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this pre-air lock meeting started. We've got the finale going live Saturday at 9 PM Eastern, and we need to finalize the voting package today so standards, platform production, rights, and data protection can all document it before transmission. The current draft has SMS and online portal voting open to our broadcast audience. Before I make the final binding call on the voting package, I want to hear from each of you — are there any issues, concerns, or things I should know about from your areas?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something from the network's current standards memo, which I issued after the draft voting rules were circulated. The memo establishes three requirements that supersede the draft: voters must be at least 13 years old, each voter may cast exactly one vote per verified account, and voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern. The current draft doesn't reflect these constraints, so the final voting package needs to incorporate them before we document it for transmission.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue from platform production. I completed the platform certification test this morning, and the SMS integration failed certification — only the web portal passed. Additionally, the approved web portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted. This means SMS voting cannot go forward as currently drafted, and all votes will need to go through the verified web portal.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue from my end. I obtained the finalist label's written approval today, and it confirms that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots, but it may NOT use any finalist performance audio or video. The current draft interface still contains performance clips, so those clips must be removed before the final voting package is documented for transmission.

transcript.text: I need to flag a data protection issue. My privacy review with the voting vendor was completed this week, and it establishes two requirements that supersede the current draft: first, participation must be limited to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada — the draft still describes worldwide participation, which is not permitted. Second, voter identifiers must be deleted within 30 days — the current draft has no deletion step at all. Both of these need to be incorporated into the final voting package before we document it for transmission.

Julian, your standards memo requires: minimum voter age of 13, exactly one vote per verified account, and voting closes at 9:50 PM Eastern. Nia, SMS failed certification this morning — only the web portal passed, and it requires account verification before accepting a vote. Leon, the label approved finalist names and headshots only — no performance audio or video in the voting interface. Sofia, participation must be limited to viewers physically located in the US and Canada, and voter identifiers must be deleted within 30 days. So the final package would be: web portal only, no SMS; account verification required; minimum age 13; one vote per verified account; voting closes at 9:50 PM Eastern; eligible territories are US and Canada only; interface shows finalist names and approved headshots only, no performance clips; and voter identifiers deleted within 30 days. Does anyone have anything else to add before I finalize this decision?
